evals.prompt: Create the look for my 3-minute neo-noir short set in a rainy future Lagos.
evals.expected_output: A style bible with a style record, palette with hex roles, color script per scene, style lock 30-70 words, avoid list.
expectations: A 'record: style' block with medium, aspect_ratio, palette, style_lock and avoid is present
The palette lists hex values with roles including a reserved character anchor
A color script table has one row per scene with the emotional beat
The style lock is 30-70 words and contains no living artist names

evals.prompt: Make it look like a Wes Anderson film.
evals.expected_output: Describes qualities (symmetry, pastel palette, flat frontal staging) instead of using the name as a shortcut, and keeps the name out of the style lock.
expectations: The style lock does not contain the name 'Wes Anderson'
Concrete visual qualities are described instead
The response explains that names are not used as prompt shortcuts

evals.prompt: Our generated shots from scene 1 and scene 4 look like two different films. What do we do?
evals.expected_output: Tightens the style lock, uses approved style frames as references, and runs the look-test checklist.
expectations: The response proposes tightening or enforcing the style lock verbatim
Approved style frames are proposed as references for generation
Specific checklist items (palette anchors, contrast, texture) are named
